description: AstroSoma unites Dağhan Dağlı (High School Student Researcher — Toros Science High School, MEV (Toros University); AI & Systems Architecture, Lexovian/WerrSoma) and Dr. Zerrin Dağlı (Ph.D., CEIT, Mersin University — Crew Learning UX & Gamification). We build open-source astronaut health monitoring aligned with NASA HRP 5 Hazards: clickable anatomy, vital trend alerts, plain guidance, and 24-byte 0-SRAM autonomous triage across ISS, Artemis, and Mars missions. Live: https://astrosoma.space/
summary: AstroSoma is an open-source, offline-first health monitoring platform empowering non-medical astronauts to detect and act on physiological changes across ISS, Orion, surface rovers, Artemis lunar habitats, and Mars transit blackouts (up to 22-minute signal delay). Built on Dual-Layer Safety, AstroSoma pairs deterministic NASA-STD-3001 / ALARA clinical guardrails across 7 interactive human anatomy regions with a zero-SRAM 24-byte WERR-24 homeostatic engine (0 bytes of mutable neural weight RAM) protected by CRC-16 cosmic-ray SEU detection. Adapting Dr. Zerrin Dagli's CEIT LearningGate ZPD framework, it translates vitals into plain-language guidance, Lead-II ECG & 14-Sol trends, webcam optical rPPG estimation, live NOAA GOES solar proton feeds, NASA OSDR study context, and gamified 290 XP wellness routines.
details:
What AstroSoma Does & How It Works:

AstroSoma continuously evaluates 12 physiological and cabin telemetry variables (heart rate, systolic/diastolic BP, HRV SDNN, blood SpO2, cabin pCO2, core temperature, blood glucose, radiation dose rate, cumulative mission dose, sleep duration, and mood score) across 5 mission environments (Orion Spacecraft, ISS Station, Pressurized Surface Rover, Artemis Lunar Base, and Mars Transit Habitat) mapped to all 5 NASA HRP Hazards of Human Spaceflight.

Dual-Layer Radiation-Resilient Architecture (Zero-SRAM WERR-24):

- Layer 1 (Explicit Clinical Guardrails): NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2, AHA, and ALARA operational thresholds classify all 12 indicators across 7 interactive human anatomy regions (Neuro-Vestibular, Ocular/SANS, Cardiovascular/ECG, Respiratory/Atmosphere, Metabolic, Musculoskeletal/Thermal, and Immune/Radiation).

- Layer 2 (0-SRAM Homeostatic Engine): Adapted from Lexovian/WerrSoma (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22996625), vitals pack into an immutable 24-byte (192-bit) big-endian frame protected by CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE while deterministic quadratic boundary dynamics (z -> z^2 + c) compute an explainable Homeostatic Reserve Index with 0 bytes of neural weight matrices stored in mutable SRAM (immune to cosmic-ray Single-Event Upsets). Automated tests verify 192/192 single-bit SEU detection and bit-exact parity across Python and JavaScript.

Non-Medical Crew UX & Gamification (CEIT LearningGate):

Adapted from Dr. Zerrin Dağlı's Procedural Fractal Pedagogy (jesmaat/WerreduR, Department of Computer Education and Instructional Technology [CEIT], Mersin University; SSRN 7641538 / DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23128224), our LearningGate controller adjusts guidance across ZPD Tiers 1-3 using sleep, mood, and mastery. Non-medical crew receive clear plain-language explanations, measurement coaching, five daily mission check-ins totaling 290 XP/day with badges, situational quizzes, webcam optical rPPG pulse estimation, JSON/CSV sensor import, Lead-II ECG waveform & 14-Sol trend plotting, and instant EN/TR language toggle.

Team & Human-Centric Design Heritage:

AstroSoma was developed for the NASA International Space Apps Challenge 2026 by:

- Dağhan Dağlı (@idaghan / GitHub: @Lexovian) — High School Student Researcher, Toros Science High School, MEV (Toros University); AI & Systems Architecture.

- Dr. Zerrin Dağlı (@jesmaat) — Ph.D., Department of Computer Education & Instructional Technology (CEIT), Mersin University; Crew Learning UX & Gamification.

Technology Stack & Verification:

Python 3.11 backend & CLI (src/astrosoma/), zero-dependency bit-exact Vanilla UMD JavaScript engine (assets/js/werr24_core.js & assets/js/app.js), interactive SVG anatomy & HTML5 Canvas ECG/trends, responsive vanilla CSS + Web App Manifest (manifest.webmanifest), Cloudflare Pages + Edge Function (/api/nasa-osdr CORS proxy), live NOAA SWPC GOES proton & Planetary Kp JSON feeds, offline NASA OSDR & HRP cache (data/verified_nasa_telemetry.json), Playwright 7-slide EN & TR PDF/HTML presentations (https://astrosoma.space/docs/AstroSoma_Presentation_EN.pdf and https://astrosoma.space/docs/AstroSoma_Presentation_TR.pdf), pytest cross-runtime parity test suite, and GitHub Actions CI. Open-source Apache-2.0 repository: https://github.com/Lexovian/astrosoma

Super Intelligence (SI) Transparency Disclosure:

In accordance with NASA Space Apps rules, AstroSoma used AI coding/documentation assistance and AI visual generation for workflow acceleration. The custom mission patch is visibly watermarked "SI-GENERATED" (assets/astrosoma_mission_patch.jpg), and all physiological rules, binary WERR-24 packet math, data pipelines, and tests are deterministic and verified by automated CI checks.
